error_description: The request to the payment service provider timed out before a response was received. Service was restored a short while later.
_label_rationale: A PSP timeout that resolved on its own is transient; the instrument was never in question.
_provenance: paraphrase of a UPI PSP downtime advisory

error_description: The issuing bank has closed this account at the customer's request. No further debits can be presented against it.
_label_rationale: A closed account is permanently unusable; retrying can never succeed.
_provenance: paraphrase of a bank account-closure notification

error_description: The account did not hold enough money to cover the instalment when it was presented for collection.
_label_rationale: Funds were short at presentment; the account itself is active and a later attempt may clear.
_provenance: paraphrase of a standard issuer decline, ISO 8583 response code 51 (not sufficient funds)

error_description: The dunning cycle for this subscription has completed without payment. The account has been handed to the collections team and no further automated attempts are scheduled.
_label_rationale: Automated recovery has been given up on and a human now owns the case.
_provenance: paraphrase of a typical dunning-cycle completion notice

error_description: A switch-level fault interrupted the transaction while it was in flight. The customer's account was not debited.
_label_rationale: A switch fault is infrastructure, not the instrument; nothing was debited so a retry is safe.
_provenance: paraphrase of ISO 8583 response code 96 (system malfunction)

error_description: The card was reported lost and the issuer has withdrawn it from circulation. A replacement has been sent to the cardholder.
_label_rationale: A withdrawn card is permanently unusable regardless of what the auth step reported.
_provenance: paraphrase of ISO 8583 response codes 41 (lost card) and 04 (pick up card)

error_description: The issuing bank's host was unavailable during its scheduled maintenance window and could not authorise the debit.
_label_rationale: Scheduled maintenance is time-bounded and the mandate remains valid afterwards.
_provenance: paraphrase of ISO 8583 response code 91 (issuer or switch inoperative)

error_description: The linked account went below the amount required for this debit before the collection was presented.
_label_rationale: A shortfall at presentment, not a defect in the instrument.
_provenance: paraphrase of a standard issuer decline, ISO 8583 response code 51 (not sufficient funds)

error_description: The stored credential was deactivated by the network after the card was reissued with a new number. The old token cannot be charged.
_label_rationale: A deactivated token is dead even though the customer still has a working card; this credential cannot be charged.
_provenance: paraphrase of a network token lifecycle deactivation notice

error_description: This mandate has already been presented the maximum number of times permitted in a single billing cycle. Further presentation requires manual review.
_label_rationale: Presentation limit reached under scheme rules; only a human can take this further.
_provenance: paraphrase of NACH e-mandate presentation-limit guidance

error_description: The beneficiary bank returned a technical decline. Other transactions to the same bank failed in the same window.
_label_rationale: A correlated failure across one bank in one window indicates an outage rather than an account problem.
_provenance: paraphrase of an acquirer downtime advisory

error_description: The validity date on the stored card is in the past, so the issuer would not authorise the debit.
_label_rationale: An out-of-date card cannot be charged again until the customer supplies a new one.
_provenance: paraphrase of ISO 8583 response code 54 (expired card)

error_description: The customer's overdraft limit had already been reached, leaving nothing available for this collection.
_label_rationale: The account is live but has no headroom right now; a later presentation may succeed.
_provenance: paraphrase of a standard issuer decline for an exceeded overdraft limit

error_description: An intermittent connectivity fault between the acquirer and the issuer caused the authorisation to drop.
_label_rationale: Connectivity between institutions, not the customer or their card.
_provenance: paraphrase of an acquirer-issuer link failure advisory

error_description: The customer has disputed this subscription and the account has been routed to the support queue pending resolution.
_label_rationale: A disputed account must not be re-presented automatically; it belongs to a human.
_provenance: paraphrase of a chargeback-dispute routing notice

error_description: The collect request expired because the remitter bank did not respond within the permitted window.
_label_rationale: An unanswered collect request is a transient bank-side failure; the mandate is intact.
_provenance: paraphrase of a UPI collect-request timeout notice

error_description: The bank has permanently frozen this account following a compliance review. Debits are no longer accepted.
_label_rationale: A permanent freeze makes the instrument unusable; a payment link to a new method is the only route.
_provenance: paraphrase of a bank compliance-freeze notification

error_description: The wallet did not carry enough value to complete the purchase at the time of checkout.
_label_rationale: A short wallet balance is a funding problem, and topping up makes a retry viable.
_provenance: paraphrase of a prepaid-wallet decline message

error_description: Every attempt configured for this billing run has now been consumed. The subscription is awaiting an agent decision.
_label_rationale: The attempt allowance is spent and the next step is explicitly a human one.
_provenance: paraphrase of a subscription-billing retry-exhaustion notice

error_description: The gateway returned a temporary failure and advised that the transaction be presented again later.
_label_rationale: The gateway itself recommends re-presentation, which is the definition of transient here.
_provenance: paraphrase of a generic gateway temporary-failure response

error_description: The cardholder has surrendered this card and the issuer has closed the underlying credit line.
_label_rationale: A surrendered card with a closed credit line cannot be charged under any circumstances.
_provenance: paraphrase of a card-surrender / account-closure notification

error_description: The balance available at the moment of the auto-debit was lower than the instalment due. The customer is expected to fund the account after payday.
_label_rationale: Explicitly a funding shortfall with a stated expectation that funds arrive later.
_provenance: paraphrase of a standard issuer decline, ISO 8583 response code 51 (not sufficient funds)

error_description: The issuer will not honour further debits on this card and has instructed that it be removed from file.
_label_rationale: An instruction to remove the card from file is a permanent stop on that instrument.
_provenance: paraphrase of ISO 8583 response code 04 (pick up card) / account updater delete advice

error_description: The connection to the bank's payment page dropped partway through and the session could not be completed.
_label_rationale: A dropped session is transient infrastructure; the customer can complete a fresh attempt.
_provenance: paraphrase of a netbanking session-interruption message

error_description: Collections has marked this balance for manual follow-up and suspended automated billing on the account.
_label_rationale: Automated billing is suspended by a deliberate business decision; a human owns it now.
_provenance: paraphrase of a collections hand-off notice

error_description: The customer cancelled the standing instruction, so the mandate backing this debit is no longer in force.
_label_rationale: Without a live mandate there is no authority to debit; a fresh authorisation is required.
_provenance: paraphrase of an e-mandate cancellation notification

error_description: There was not enough money in the account on the due date to satisfy the standing instruction.
_label_rationale: A funding shortfall against a live standing instruction; the mandate is still valid.
_provenance: paraphrase of a standard issuer decline, ISO 8583 response code 51 (not sufficient funds)

error_description: The issuer's authorisation system reported that it was busy and could not process the request at that moment.
_label_rationale: A busy authorisation host is temporary by definition and the card remains valid.
_provenance: paraphrase of ISO 8583 response code 96 (system malfunction) / 91 (issuer inoperative)

error_description: We have contacted the customer repeatedly about this failure without a reply, and no further automatic collection will be attempted.
_label_rationale: Outreach is over and automated collection has been stopped, which is escalation rather than a retry.
_provenance: paraphrase of a typical dunning-cycle completion notice

error_description: A deceased-account marker was returned by the bank and the relationship is being closed.
_label_rationale: The account is closing permanently; no automated collection against it is appropriate or possible.
_provenance: paraphrase of a deceased-account return code advisory
